description: This file contains the abstract class ModelWidget, which serves as the base class for widget models in the OFBiz framework. It includes properties for widget metadata such as name and system ID, constructors for instantiation, and methods related to widget boundary comments and border types. It also includes an abstract accept method for visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: ModelWidget
classes.description: An abstract class representing a widget in the OFBiz framework, providing common metadata and behavior for widget models.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Abstract method to accept a visitor for processing the widget, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getSystemId
methods.description: Returns the URL or identifier where the widget was defined.

methods.name: getStartColumn
methods.description: Returns the starting column position of the widget in its source XML.

methods.name: getStartLine
methods.description: Returns the starting line number of the widget in its source XML.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the widget by visiting it with an XmlWidgetVisitor.

methods.name: getBoundaryCommentName
methods.description: Returns the name used in boundary comments; defaults to the widget's name.

methods.name: widgetBoundaryCommentsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if boundary comments are enabled based on properties and context.

methods.name: widgetNamedBorderType
methods.description: Returns the border type setting for development use, based on properties.
